```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#Resistance sutface for Etosha wet/dry 
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)

# 0. Configuring
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label   <- "etosha"
years_range <- 2008:2020
 
gee_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data")
lc_dist_folder  <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
evi_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
model_folder    <- here("outputs")
out_folder      <- here("outputs", "resistance_surfaces")
dir.create(out_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
lc_types    <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")
wet_months  <- c(1:4, 11:12)
dry_months  <- c(5:10)
 
crop_extent <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5) 
target_res  <- 0.0045 # 500m in degrees 
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

# 1. Load fitted SSF modles
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
m0_etosha_wet <- readRDS(file.path(model_folder, "m0_etosha_wet.rds"))
m0_etosha_dry <- readRDS(file.path(model_folder, "m0_etosha_dry.rds"))

# 2. Build static covariate raster (seaonal)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_static_stack <- function() {
 
  static_files <- c(
    core_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "core_dist_rast_500m_new.tif"),
    fence_dist = file.path(gee_folder, "fences_dist_rast_500m.tif"),
    road_dist  = file.path(gee_folder, "roads_distance_rast_500m.tif")
  )
 
  r_list <- map(static_files, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- names(static_files)
 
  terrain_r <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "terrain_rast_500m.tif"))
  terrain_r <- project(terrain_r, template, method = "bilinear")
  
  c(r_stack, terrain_r)
}

#Linear feature stack 
build_linear_stack <- function() {
 
  linear_types <- c("hydrorivers", "kaza_vet_fences", "roads")
  linear_folder <- here("data", "Linear_features")
 
  r_list <- map(linear_types, function(feature) {
    fp <- file.path(linear_folder, paste0(feature, "_linear_500m.tif"))
    project(rast(fp), template, method = "near")
  })
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(linear_types, "_linear")
 
  r_stack
}

# 3. Build land-cover distance stack, average across year 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_lc_dist_mean <- function(years = years_range) {
 
  yearly_stacks <- map(years, function(yr) {
    r_list <- map(lc_types, function(lc) {
      fp <- file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc, "_", yr, ".tif"))
      if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
      project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
    })
    r_list <- compact(r_list) 
    if (length(r_list) == 0) return(NULL)
    r <- rast(r_list)
    names(r) <- paste0(lc_types[seq_along(r_list)], "_dist")
    r
  })
  yearly_stacks <- compact(yearly_stacks)
 
  #mean across years, per land-cover type
  lc_mean <- rast(map(lc_types, function(lc) {
    layer_name <- paste0(lc, "_dist")
    layers_for_type <- rast(map(yearly_stacks, function(s) {
      if (layer_name %in% names(s)) s[[layer_name]] else NULL
    }) |> compact())
    mean(layers_for_type, na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  names(lc_mean) <- paste0(lc_types, "_dist")
  lc_mean
}

# 4. Build EVI mean surface for given season
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_evi_mean <- function(season, years = years_range) {
 
  if (season == "dry") {
    r_list <- map(years, function(yr) {
      fp <- file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", yr, ".tif"))
      if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
      r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
      names(r) <- "evi"
      r
    })
  } else {
    # wet season files span year boundaries: evi_wet_(yr-1)_(yr).tif
    r_list <- map(years, function(yr) {
      fp <- file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", yr - 1, "_", yr, ".tif"))
      if (!file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
      r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
      names(r) <- "evi"
      r
    })
  }
  r_list <- compact(r_list)
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  evi_mean <- mean(r_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(evi_mean) <- "evi"
  evi_mean
}

# 5. Build population mean surface across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_world_pop_mean <- function(years = years_range) {
  world_pop <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
  world_pop <- project(world_pop, template, method = "bilinear")
  world_pop_list <- split(world_pop, 1:nlyr(world_pop))
 
  layer_idx <- years - 1999  #matches indexing used in the SSF extraction script
  layer_idx <- layer_idx[layer_idx >= 1 & layer_idx <= length(world_pop_list)]
 
  pop_stack <- rast(world_pop_list[layer_idx])
  pop_mean <- mean(pop_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(pop_mean) <- "world_pop"
  pop_mean
}

# 6. Full covariate stack for one season
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_covariate_stack <- function(season) {
  static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
  linear_stack  <- build_linear_stack()
  lc_stack      <- build_lc_dist_mean()
  evi_stack     <- build_evi_mean(season)
  pop_stack     <- build_world_pop_mean()
 
 full_stack <- c(static_stack, linear_stack, lc_stack, evi_stack, pop_stack)
  full_stack
}

# 7. Predict linear predictor / SSF from model coefficients
# -----------------------------------------------------------

predict_ssf_surface <- function(model, covariate_stack) {
 
  betas <- coef(model)
 
  missing_in_stack <- setdiff(names(betas), names(covariate_stack))
  if (length(missing_in_stack) > 0) {
    warning("Covariates in model but missing from raster stack: ",
            paste(missing_in_stack, collapse = ", "),
            " -- these terms will be dropped from the prediction.")
  }
 
  common_names <- intersect(names(betas), names(covariate_stack))
  stack_sub <- covariate_stack[[common_names]]
  betas_sub <- betas[common_names]
 
  #multiply each layer by its coefficient, then sum across layers
  weighted <- stack_sub * betas_sub
  lp <- sum(weighted, na.rm = TRUE)   #linear predictor surface
  names(lp) <- "linear_predictor"
  lp
  
}

# 8. Linear predictor to resistance surface
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lp_to_resistance <- function(lp, min_resistance = 1, max_resistance = 100) {
 
  w <- exp(lp)  #calculates relative selection strength (w)
 
  #normalize selection strength between 0 and 1 
  w_min <- global(w, "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  w_max <- global(w, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  w_norm <- (w - w_min) / (w_max - w_min)
 
  #Method 1: invert high selection strength to low resistance which assumes linear mapping between selection preference (w) and landscape resistance
 # resistance <- min_resistance + (max_resistance - min_resistance) * (1 - w_norm)
 # names(resistance) <- "resistance"
  #resistance
  
  # or Method 2:  Non-linear Exponential Resistance Transformation
  # R = 1 + (max_res - min_res) * exp(-c * w_norm)
  #As w_norm approaches 1 (high selection), resistance approaches min_resistance 
  #As w_norm appraoches 0 (lower selection), resistance rises rapidly toward max-resistance 
  res_raw <- exp(-shape_parameter * w_norm) # shape_parameter keeps curve flatter closer to 0.1 and steeply penalizes non-selected habitats 
  #Rescale the transformed surace to target [min_resistance, max_resistance]
  r_min <- global(res_raw, "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  r_max <- global(res_raw, "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1, 1]
  resistance <- min_resistance + (max_resistance - min_resistance) * ((res_raw - r_min) / (r_max - r_min))
  names(resistance) <- "resistance"
  
  return(resistance)
 
}

#9. Run 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_resistance_pipeline <- function(model, season, pop_label) {
  message ("Building covariate stack for ", pop_label, "-", season,)
  cov_stack <- build_covariate_stack(season)
  
  message ("Predicting linear predictor surface")
  lp <- predict_ssf_surface(model, cov_stack)
  
 message("Converting to resistance surface") 
  resistance <- lp_to_resistance(lp)
  
  out_path <- file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season, ".tif"))
  writeRaster(resistance, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("saved", out_path)
}
```
